description: Comprehensive AI skills for the Symfony UX ecosystem — Stimulus, Turbo, LiveComponent, Twig Components, Autocomplete, and Icons. Provides instructions, code examples, decision trees, and best practices for building modern interactive Symfony applications.
rules: Use Symfony 7.x conventions and PHP 8.2+ syntax
Follow Symfony UX official documentation patterns
Always include {{ attributes }} on the root element of Twig Components and LiveComponents
Prefer AssetMapper over Webpack Encore for new projects
Use data-model for two-way binding in LiveComponents
Use Turbo Frames for scoped navigation, Turbo Streams for targeted DOM updates
Prefer Stimulus for JS behavior over vanilla JS or jQuery
